entities.name: Abdullah ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib was one of Ali's sons who was killed in Karbala in 680, and is considered among the martyrs of the Battle of Karbala. Abdullah is also among the four sons of Umm al-Banin, the daughter of Hazam. His kunya was Abu Muhammad.
